summary.zh: 点击时从点击位置扩散一圈涟漪，键盘触发时从中心扩散
summary.en: A ripple spreads from the click point; from the centre when triggered by keyboard

ref: Magic UI · Ripple Button（独立实现）

reduced.zh: 不扩散，按下时按钮变暗一点
reduced.en: No ripple; the button darkens slightly while pressed

dont_use.zh: 很小的图标按钮；点击后立刻跳转或消失的按钮；按钮上有超出边框的角标（会被裁掉）
dont_use.en: Tiny icon buttons; buttons that navigate or vanish instantly; buttons with badges overflowing the border (they get clipped)
